name: Custom AI Agent (burp-ai-agent)
description: Burp Suite extension (Custom AI Agent) that lets models and MCP clients drive Burp and adds AI scanners with fixed payload markers
seenIn: No public report of use in an attack. Covered from its source code

indicators.context: Marker in the eight reflected XSS payloads of the Custom AI Agent Burp extension's active scanners, e.g. <script>alert('XSS-BURP-AI-1337')</script>; reflected XSS is tested on every insertion point (scanner/PayloadGenerator.kt:49-99)
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the burp-ai-agent source code

indicators.context: Marker in its DOM XSS payloads #<script>alert('DOM-XSS-BURP-AI')</script> and '-alert('DOM-XSS-BURP-AI')-' (scanner/PayloadGenerator.kt:111,125)
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the burp-ai-agent source code

indicators.context: Value in its header and CRLF injection payloads: X-Injected: burp-ai-test and Set-Cookie: burp-ai-test=true, raw and URL-encoded (scanner/PayloadGenerator.kt:237-261)
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the burp-ai-agent source code

indicators.context: Made-up domain in its OAuth redirect payloads: https://evil-burp-ai.com/callback, legitimate.com.evil-burp-ai.com, legitimate.com@evil-burp-ai.com (scanner/PayloadGenerator.kt:463-484). Not checked whether it resolves; a server looking it up followed a payload

indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the burp-ai-agent source code
